scope: Desktop lossless size study of existing839-record archival reference. No watch wire format, codec implementation, native RAM, object-store size, CPU or energy acceptance. Archive unchanged; no duplicate full encodings stored.
columnarMethod: Each homogeneous entity collection stores its column names once and every complete row as an array; nested values/metadata retained. Reconstruct by exact column zip; no IDs/precision/names/unknowns dropped. String-table pooling not included.
decision: Use compact bounded JSON as initial wire baseline; compare columnar/short-key/shared-string layouts only on measured FR165 workloads before accepting complexity. Do not send the full catalog even if compressed.
additionalCheck: Canonical JSON byte equality with sorted keys and finite numbers; distinguishes bool/number, null/zero, strings and numeric representations.
